weapons.name: Lightning Conductor
weapons.behavior: Shoots one bolt at the nearest enemy, then arcs to nearby enemies with reduced damage.

weapons.name: Inferno Sprayer
weapons.behavior: Shoots a fire projectile that burns its target; Infernal Heart unlocks an explosive evolution.

weapons.name: Crimson Daggers
weapons.behavior: Dagues en orbite autour du joueur, non lancées ; Blood Chalice débloque Bleed avec Bloodstorm.

weapons.name: Void Orb
weapons.behavior: A slow orb pierces enemies and pulls nearby foes toward its path.

weapons.name: Frost Nova
weapons.behavior: Damages and chills enemies around you; Frozen Crown unlocks its level 5 evolution.

weapons.name: Minigun
weapons.behavior: Rapidly fires at the nearest enemy; Overdrive Engine increases its fire rate.

weapons.name: Meteor Staff
weapons.behavior: Targets an enemy group and explodes on impact; Celestial Eye unlocks Starfall.

weapons.name: Sawblades
weapons.behavior: Fires a sawblade that ricochets between enemies; Magnetic Coil unlocks Razorstorm.

weapons.name: Toxic Cloud
weapons.behavior: Creates a poison cloud on impact that damages and poisons nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Prism Laser
weapons.behavior: Prioritizes the highest-health enemy in a dense cluster; Prism Crystal unlocks secondary beams at level 5.

relics.name: Storm Core
relics.behavior: +5% global damage per level; collect Infinite Circuit when both it and Lightning Conductor reach level 5.

relics.name: Infernal Heart
relics.behavior: +5% global attack speed per level; collect Wildfire when both it and Inferno Sprayer reach level 5.

relics.name: Blood Chalice
relics.behavior: +5% global lifesteal and +10% kill healing per level; collect Bloodstorm when both it and Crimson Daggers reach level 5.

relics.name: Singularity
relics.behavior: +5% global cooldown reduction per level; collect Event Horizon when both it and Void Orb reach level 5.

relics.name: Frozen Crown
relics.behavior: +5% global area per level; collect Absolute Zero when both it and Frost Nova reach level 5.

relics.name: Overdrive Engine
relics.behavior: +4% global attack speed per level; collect Redline when both it and Minigun reach level 5.

relics.name: Celestial Eye
relics.behavior: +3% global area per level; collect Starfall when both it and Meteor Staff reach level 5.

relics.name: Magnetic Coil
relics.behavior: +4% global projectile speed per level; collect Razorstorm when both it and Sawblades reach level 5.

relics.name: Plague Mask
relics.behavior: +5% global damage per level; collect Pandemic when both it and Toxic Cloud reach level 5.

relics.name: Prism Crystal
relics.behavior: +3% global critical damage per level; collect Spectrum Collapse when both it and Prism Laser reach level 5.

relics.name: Magnet Heart
relics.behavior: +25% global pickup radius per level; it does not attract chests.
